The yarn is a single yarn of an intimate blend of staple fibers, with polyester at 51.7% and cotton at 48.3%. It is not put up for retail sale, so it falls in heading 5509 (yarn of synthetic staple fibers, not put up for retail sale) or 5511. Because polyester staple is 85% or more? No, it is only 51.7%, so the relevant heading is 5509.5x ("other yarn, of polyester staple fibers"). Within 5509.5, the sub-breakouts are:
- 5509.51: mixed mainly or solely with artificial staple fibers
- 5509.52: mixed mainly or solely with wool or fine animal hair
- 5509.53: mixed mainly or solely with cotton
- 5509.59: other

The cotton blend therefore goes to 5509.53. The HTSUS statistical suffixes under 5509.53 are:
- 5509.53.00: Mixed mainly or solely with cotton
- 5509.53.0000 is the 10-digit form (a single line)

Checking the actual HTS, 5509.53.00 has 5509.53.0030 (Single yarn, not combed?) and 5509.53.0060 (Other). I recall 5509.53.00 with statistical suffixes 30 and 60: "Single yarn" and "Multiple (folded) or cabled yarn." That is the breakdown I'll use. The product is a single yarn, so 5509.53.0030.
